result:
Clean. Summary of the change:

- **`src/attr/_make.py`**: `_transform_attrs` no longer forces inherited (`base_attrs`) attributes to `kw_only=True` when the class-level `kw_only=True` is set — only attributes defined directly on the class (`own_attrs`) are affected now, matching `dataclasses.dataclass(kw_only=True)` semantics.
- **`src/attr/_next_gen.py`**: documented this behavior in `attrs.define`'s `kw_only` docstring.
- **`tests/test_make.py`**: updated `test_kw_only` and `test_keyword_only_class_level_subclassing` to assert the new (dataclasses-consistent) behavior instead of the old blanket propagation.
- **`changelog.d/1457.change.md`**: added changelog fragment.

Full test suite (1354 tests) passes. Note: running tests in this environment requires `PYTHONPATH` pointed at `src` explicitly — a stray user-site `attrs` 26.1.0 install otherwise shadows the local package when invoked via the `pytest` executable.
